_readme: Captured by hand from the three live Play Store listings on 2026-11-05 and used only as an offline fallback by tools/research_probe.py. Every entry is a capability stated in the listing text; the 'evidence' field is the phrase it came from. Nothing here is inferred.

evidence.aiming: Aim and match the bubble you want to shoot in the bubble.
evidence.boosters: Click on the props in the game, the use of props allows you to easily through the game
evidence.stars: The game will give you the stars based on your performance in the game
evidence.characters: cute dragon hiding in the depths of bubble jungle
evidence.levels: Well designed level, not only fun but also a lot

evidence.aiming: Tap on the bubble and switch the bubble to that fits your match. Swipe to control the candy shooter for a precise bubble shot
evidence.match3: Three or more consecutive bubbles cause it to blast.
evidence.map_adventure: Beat levels to unlock new episodes and receive extra bubble shooter rewards!
evidence.combo_chain: Consecutively breaking balls can add points.
evidence.boosters: There're new bubbles, marvelous new boosters, fire balls, genies and bubble boosters!
evidence.visual_fx: Smooth animation and interesting music keep you immersed for hours!
evidence.offline: Enjoy Bubble Shooter offline whenever and wherever you want!

evidence.daily_reward: login daily to collect daily rewards
evidence.economy: Earn coins to buy cool boosters
evidence.colorblind_mode: Colorblind mode: all balloons, balls and bubbles have the same color!
evidence.boosters: Pop 7 bubbles in a row to unlock the fireball. Drop 10+ bubbles at once to get a bomb.
evidence.combo_chain: Pop 7 bubbles in a row to unlock the fireball.
evidence.laser_aim: Tap to drag the laser aim and lift it to take a shot.
evidence.levels: 3000 + Exciting levels, with more, added all the time.
evidence.obstacles: Clear obstacles and beat the challenges.
evidence.classic_mode: Play the Classic Mode - So Simple
evidence.offline: no wifi or internet connection is needed!
